Before signing in, prepare a Google Cloud project with billing enabled; without billing Google does not answer. New customers get $300 credit for 90 days.\n\nHow to enable billing on the project: at console.cloud.google.com open the menu ☰ → \'Billing\' → \'Manage billing accounts\' → \'My projects\' tab. In the row of the project that says \'Billing is disabled\', open \'⋮\' (Actions) → \'Change billing\', choose a billing account and press \'Set account\'. If you do not have a billing account yet, Google offers to create one.
